activity.notes: Mencius was an itinerant Warring States philosopher rather than a ruler. The received Mencius preserves repeated interviews with King Xuan of Qi, while modern scholarship dates Mencius' securely datable late-life encounters with rulers to approximately 323-314 BCE. Because King Xuan's reign began in 319 BCE, ATLAS uses c.319-c.314 as a deliberately conservative overlap window for Mencius' attested intellectual-political activity at the Qi court. The relation is active_in; the record does not assert continuous formal office throughout this span, and both boundaries are explicitly approximate.

sources.title: Mencius (Mengzi) — Internet Encyclopedia of Philosophy
sources.citation_text: The IEP notes that Mencius' encounters with rulers in old age can be dated between 323 and 314 BCE and that he is traditionally associated with service in Qi.

sources.title: Mengzi: Liang Hui Wang I — Chinese Text Project
sources.citation_text: The transmitted text directly records Mencius in dialogue with King Xuan of Qi on royal government.
